description: Browse The Guardian's content by section or tag, or discover available sections and tags for use as filters. Four modes: "section_latest" returns the newest articles from a section (requires section_id); "tag_latest" returns newest articles carrying a tag (requires tag_id); "list_sections" returns all Guardian sections for use as section filters; "list_tags" searches the tag taxonomy (optional: query, tag_type). Start with list_sections or list_tags when you don't know valid section/tag IDs. Powered by The Guardian (open-platform.theguardian.com).

mode.description: Operation mode. "section_latest": newest articles from a section (requires section_id). "tag_latest": newest articles carrying a tag (requires tag_id). "list_sections": return all Guardian sections for use as section filters. "list_tags": search the tag taxonomy (optional: query, tag_type, section).

page.description: Page number (1-indexed). Use with total/pages in the response to paginate.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (1–50). Applies to all modes. For article-returning modes (section_latest, tag_latest), keep ≤10 to manage context size.

query.description: For list_tags mode: search term to filter the tag taxonomy (e.g. "climate" to find climate-related tags). For list_sections mode: filter sections by name. Ignored for section_latest and tag_latest.

section_id.description: Section ID for section_latest mode (e.g. "world", "politics", "science", "environment", "technology", "culture", "sport", "lifeandstyle"). Required for section_latest. Use list_sections first if unsure of valid IDs.

tag_id.description: Tag ID for tag_latest mode (e.g. "environment/climate-crisis", "technology/artificial-intelligence", "world/ukraine"). Supports comma (AND), pipe | (OR), hyphen - (NOT), and parentheses, e.g. environment/climate-crisis|environment/flooding. Required for tag_latest. Use list_tags first to discover valid tag IDs.

tag_type.description: For list_tags mode: restrict to tags of this type. "contributor" returns author profiles. "keyword" returns topic tags (most common). "series" returns article series. "newspaper-book" and "newspaper-book-section" cover print categories. Omit to return all types.

name: guardian_browse_content

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unauthorized`: The Guardian API returned 401 — the API key is missing or invalid. `missing_section_id`: mode is section_latest but section_id is not provided. `missing_tag_id`: mode is tag_latest but tag_id is not provided. `section_not_found`: The given section_id does not match any Guardian section. `tag_not_found`: The given tag_id returned no content. `request_rejected`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 400. `access_denied`: The Guardian API denied access. `validation_failed`: The Guardian API rejected a parameter value. `invalid_request`: The Guardian API cannot serve this request. `request_conflict`: The Guardian API reported a request conflict. `request_not_found`: The Guardian API could not find the requested endpoint. `api_timeout`: The Guardian request timed out or the API returned a timeout status. `rate_limited`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 429. `api_unsupported`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 501. `api_error`: The Guardian API returned a retryable server failure (excluding HTTP 501), an HTML error page, or a network failure. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mode.description: Browse mode that produced this response. "section_latest"/"tag_latest": results[] is populated. "list_sections": sections[] is populated. "list_tags": tags[] is populated.

page.description: Current page number. Present for section_latest, tag_latest, and list_tags modes.

pages.description: Total pages available. Present for section_latest, tag_latest, and list_tags modes.

results.description: Recent articles. Populated for section_latest and tag_latest modes.

body.description: Article body text (HTML stripped). Truncated at 2,000 words. Absent on galleries, live blogs, and interactives.

id.description: Article ID. Pass to guardian_get_article for the full untruncated text.

truncated.description: True when body was truncated at 2,000 words.

word_count.description: Article word count (absent on some content types).

sections.description: All Guardian sections. Populated for list_sections mode.

id.description: Section ID — use as the section parameter in guardian_search_articles or guardian_browse_content section_latest mode.

name.description: Display name (normalized from wire field webTitle).

tags.description: Matching tags. Populated for list_tags mode.

id.description: Tag ID — use as the tag parameter in guardian_search_articles or guardian_browse_content tag_latest mode.

name.description: Display name (normalized from wire field webTitle).

section_id.description: Section this tag belongs to (when applicable).

type.description: Tag type: keyword, contributor, blog, series, tone, newspaper-book, newspaper-book-section, type, publication.

total.description: Total items available (articles, sections, or tags).

totalCount.description: Total items available (articles, sections, or tags) — discloses how many exist beyond this capped page.

title: Browse Guardian Content
